JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvnhan_pth_ubndtp` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `luong_giao`,
    `nhom_van_ban`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua`,
    `ld_ubnd`,
    `ld_van_phong`,
    `phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi`,
    `chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi`,
    `sync_date`
)



SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* LUỒNG GIAO: đơn vị nhận = 490.698, hoặc qlnv_task_user có user thuộc đúng 490.698 */
    IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment = '490.698' OR MAX(ppl.co_user_ubnd) = 1,
       'Qua UBND', 'Không qua UBND')                        AS luong_giao,

    /* NHÓM VĂN BẢN: gắn tên theo số ký hiệu văn bản giao (DocCode) */
    CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB/(KL|TU|VPTU)' THEN 'TBKL Thành ủy'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'CV/(TU|VPTU)'    THEN 'CV Thành ủy'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'             THEN 'Triển khai thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS nhom_van_ban,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. NHIỆM VỤ & THÔNG TIN GIAO */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(MAX(d_assign.name), NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ / CHUYÊN VIÊN */
    t.OriginalTargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    MAX(d_chutri.name)                                      AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    MAX(ppl.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien)                 AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    /* 5. MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4) AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL                                      THEN 'Thường xuyên'
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        THEN IF(t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE(), 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn', 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn')
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ: báo cáo mới nhất, fallback nội dung task */
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT rp.Content
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
         WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
         ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC
         LIMIT 1),
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 8. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG (tính sẵn trong ppl) & CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI (người tạo thuộc 490.698.752) */
    MAX(ppl.ld_ubnd)                                        AS ld_ubnd,
    MAX(ppl.ld_van_phong)                                   AS ld_van_phong,
    IF(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(MAX(d_create.name), ''), NULL)             AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    IF(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''), NULL) AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* LỌC NHÓM VĂN BẢN 55, 111, 132, 129 */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
       AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 111, 132, 129)

/* Không dùng nữa: nhom_van_ban lấy theo DocCode
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution_group` rg
        ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
       AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL
*/

/* Các JOIN department: chỉ CAST khi id là số (INSERT ... SELECT ở strict mode sẽ lỗi nếu CAST chuỗi rỗng/không phải số) */

/* TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                                CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

/* ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: nhánh 1841/1307/1310 lấy cấp 4, còn lại lấy id cuối của TargetDepartment */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = IF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), t.OriginalTargetDepartment), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
              CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), t.OriginalTargetDepartment), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED),
              NULL)
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI TẠO & PHÒNG BAN NGƯỜI TẠO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create
       ON d_create.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI LIÊN QUAN THEO TASK: tính 1 lần cho mọi task (thay cho subquery tương quan từng dòng)
   Nguồn p.src: 0 = qlnv_task_user (đơn vị tu.DepartmentId), 1 = TargetUser (đơn vị TargetDepartment)
   - co_user_ubnd : có user qlnv_task_user thuộc đúng 490.698 (cho luong_giao)
   - ld_ubnd      : đơn vị = 490.698 (ưu tiên đơn vị của nguồn), chức danh Lãnh đạo, Level = 2
   - ld_van_phong : đơn vị = 490.698.752 (ưu tiên u.DepartmentPath)
   - lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien: chỉ qlnv_task_user, user thuộc đơn vị chủ trì
   - Trùng user giữa 2 nguồn loại bằng GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ...) */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.TaskId,
        MAX(p.src = 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698') AS co_user_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dept, u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
                  AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
                  AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698.752'
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_van_phong,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN p.src = 0
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE '490.698%'
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE CONCAT(
                          IF(p.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), p.OriginalTargetDepartment), '%')
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title,
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.Role, ujt.job_title, u.eGovUserFullname SEPARATOR ', ') AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien

    FROM (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 0 AS src, tu.Role, tu.Id, tu.UserId,
               NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '') AS dept, t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2 ON t2.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE t2.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
          AND COALESCE(t2.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 1, NULL, NULL, t2.OriginalTargetUser,
               NULLIF(t2.OriginalTargetDepartment, ''), t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
          AND COALESCE(t2.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
          AND t2.OriginalTargetUser IS NOT NULL
    ) p
    /* LEFT JOIN: giữ dòng task_user không có user (co_user_ubnd vẫn xét tu.DepartmentId) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
           ON u.eGovUserId = p.UserId

    /* CHỨC DANH MỖI USER (tính 1 lần): đúng phòng ban hiện tại > is_primary > id mới nhất.
       MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER -> ghép khóa sắp xếp cố định 14 ký tự rồi lấy MAX */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT udpj.user_id,
               NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(MAX(CONCAT(
                   IF(CAST(udpj.department_id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(uu.DepartmentPath, '.', -1), 1, 0),
                   IF(udpj.is_primary > 0, 1, 0),
                   LPAD(udpj.id, 12, '0'),
                   COALESCE(jt.JobTitlesName, '')
               )), 15)), '') AS job_title
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`user_department_position_jobtitle` udpj
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`jobtitles` jt ON jt.JobTitlesId = udpj.jobtitle_id
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` uu ON uu.eGovUserId = udpj.user_id
        WHERE COALESCE(udpj.status, 1) = 1
        GROUP BY udpj.user_id
    ) ujt
           ON ujt.user_id = u.eGovUserId

    GROUP BY p.TaskId
) ppl
    ON ppl.TaskId = t.TaskId

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
  /* NHIỆM VỤ THÀNH ỦY GIAO (490.695%): chỉ lấy khi DocCode là TBKL / CV Thành ủy / NQ 57-NQ/TW */
  AND (   COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.695%'
       OR t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB/(KL|TU|VPTU)|CV/(TU|VPTU)|BCĐ')

GROUP BY t.TaskId

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: All FlowFiles are routed to this relationship

Log Level.name: Log Level
Log Level.description: The Log Level to use when logging the Attributes

Log Payload.name: Log Payload
Log Payload.description: If true, the FlowFile's payload will be logged, in addition to its attributes; otherwise, just the Attributes will be logged.

Attributes to Log.name: Attributes to Log
Attributes to Log.description: A comma-separated list of Attributes to Log. If not specified, all attributes will be logged unless `Attributes to Log by Regular Expression` is modified. There's an AND relationship between the two properties.

attributes-to-log-regex.name: attributes-to-log-regex
attributes-to-log-regex.displayName: Attributes to Log by Regular Expression
attributes-to-log-regex.description: A regular expression indicating the Attributes to Log. If not specified, all attributes will be logged unless `Attributes to Log` is modified. There's an AND relationship between the two properties.

Attributes to Ignore.name: Attributes to Ignore
Attributes to Ignore.description: A comma-separated list of Attributes to ignore. If not specified, no attributes will be ignored unless `Attributes to Ignore by Regular Expression` is modified. There's an OR relationship between the two properties.

attributes-to-ignore-regex.name: attributes-to-ignore-regex
attributes-to-ignore-regex.displayName: Attributes to Ignore by Regular Expression
attributes-to-ignore-regex.description: A regular expression indicating the Attributes to Ignore. If not specified, no attributes will be ignored unless `Attributes to Ignore` is modified. There's an OR relationship between the two properties.

Log FlowFile Properties.name: Log FlowFile Properties
Log FlowFile Properties.description: Specifies whether or not to log FlowFile "properties", such as Entry Date, Lineage Start Date, and content size

Output Format.name: Output Format
Output Format.description: Specifies the format to use for logging FlowFile attributes

allowableValue.description: Each FlowFile attribute will be logged using a single line for the attribute name and another line for the attribute value. This format is often most advantageous when looking at the attributes of a single FlowFile.
All FlowFile attribute names and values will be logged on a single line. This format is often most advantageous when comparing logs from multiple FlowFiles.

Log prefix.name: Log prefix
Log prefix.description: Log prefix appended to the log lines. It helps to distinguish the output of multiple LogAttribute processors.

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: The name of the CharacterSet to use

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.
